answer_1.quote: ATG is a perplexity-based decoding strategy inspired by previous studies using perplexity for dementia detection. As shown in Figure, given a training set and an instruction, ATG generates a human-understandable Feature Context, which could be used for perplexity-based classification.
answer_1.outputs: feature contexts that highlight differences between healthy and dementia transcripts

answer_2.quote: For each c_{n+1}, we calculate the PPL-F value as the difference of the mean perplexity score of two classes, i.e., mean(PPL_M(D_d^train, I, C_n||c_{n+1}))-mean(PPL_M(D_h^train, I, C_n||c_{n+1})).
